body.en: A family of algorithms that locate a boundary in a monotone search space by testing a midpoint and preserving the half that can still contain the answer.

body.en: In the half-open form [low, high), the answer is never outside the interval. Each branch must shrink that interval.

body.en: Each iteration reduces the remaining interval by roughly half while storing only boundary indices.
